title: 第580章 其实，我早就是幽冥人了
content_zh:
虽然冥府也能遮掩耳目，但在第七洞天合并的关键时期，一个先天法身境的大活人突然失踪，未免太过显眼。

所以楚墨这才借来了素天图。

至于执素为何突然改变主意，他心中也有所预料。无非是想借素天图来留下自己动手后的痕迹，从而进行复刻模仿。

“可惜，我最不怕的就是被人学我了。”

彩蝶想了想，她确实记得上次沈明轩采了一株奇草回来，却不知下人们将那剩下的奇草放到哪儿了。

“怎么了，是不是又乱想了呀。”他知道她向来有爱乱想的冲动，于是坐在床边握着她的手。

此时，她的手安然地被身旁的男人包裹在掌中，她心中已经了无遗憾，即使只能陪他走到这里，她也心满意足。其他的人，其他的事情，他是不是皇帝，都和她无关，更不在她在乎的范围之内。

凌菲还以为是楼底下的人听见她的呼喊，所以才迈着慵懒的步伐上来，但她已经完全忘记了，现在是凌晨。

丁九溪在脑中急速飞转给玄澈想了这样的一个解决办法，丁九溪并不是乘人之危要玄澈给丁兮辰当老师，而是在这个节骨眼上，似乎这个理由才是最有说服力的，也许这就是老天冥冥之中赐予丁九溪让她抓住的机会吧。

步清幽的一番话让云万一愣在那里，刹那间不知道该说什么什么好，良久才恍惚跟着她离开了景阳宫，朝着自己的宫中走去，一路上沉浸在自己的思绪之中，不能自拔。

“娘，你不必担心，珠儿现在不是好好的吗？”盛明珠撒娇说着，视线却瞥了苏清婉一眼。

阴王丝毫不给面子，那高傲的样子，好像恨不得要将他给踩在脚底下。

韩毅怒瞪着她，恨不得立刻将她杀死，不过这也是一时间的冲动而已。

“其实你不必想太多了，若是你有空，便去同心殿里找我，我也会让皇上帮你叫来裴大人的。”林初夏握着晴妃的手，说道。

她缓缓走向那座亭子，夜未央正坐在石凳上，上面摆了一壶酒，两个杯盏，似乎早就在这里等她了。

“汪阿姨，我叫关毅，这时我妻子沐蓉，她的父亲是沐广鸿……”关毅热情地向汪素琴介绍了自己二人的身份。

但就在这时，可不好了，只见灵光一闪，信城主只感觉似是有一根钢针径直从头顶插入，痛的信城主一声惨叫，险些没背过气去。而就在这时，只见路西法另只手猛然在信城主的胸前一拍。

她好不容易，才从情蛊的痛苦之中恢复过来，好不容易才决定要忘记过去的一切，换个身份重新开始。

如今虽然诸多变数，还没当上皇帝，却也迈出半步，成了王爷，这男人以命相搏，前途在他眼里重过一切，为了皇位他可以牺牲所有。

“这是你们班的学生吧，你看看都几点了，怎么迟到这么久？”张翠萍指了指楚枫，大有一副兴师问罪的模样。

三人一阵无语，就这么简单吗？那么自己等人费心费力的苦熬三个月，岂不是自虐吗？

白墨卿显然也发现了事情的蹊跷，在一旁安安静静的打量着夜安眠，似乎想从夜安眠的脸上发现什么秘密。

“好了闲话到这里就结束了，现在我们正式开始今天的课程。”老师拍了拍手掌，将众人从沮丧的情绪中拉了回来。
content_en:
Although the underworld can also cover the eyes and ears, it is too conspicuous for a living person in the innate Dharmakaya realm to suddenly disappear during the critical period of the merger of the seventh cave and heaven.

That's why Chu Mo borrowed Su Tian Tu.

As for why Zhi Su suddenly changed his mind, he had also expected it.It is nothing more than wanting to use Su Tian Tu to leave traces of his own work, so that he can imitate it.

"Unfortunately, the thing I'm least afraid of is being imitated by others."

Caidi thought for a while, she did remember that Shen Mingxuan picked a strange grass last time, but she didn't know where the servants put the remaining strange grass.

"What's wrong? Are you thinking wildly again?" He knew that she always had the urge to think wildly, so he sat by the bed and held her hand.

At this moment, her hand was safely wrapped in the palm of the man beside her. She had no regrets in her heart. Even if she could only accompany him till this point, she would be satisfied.Other people, other things, whether he was the emperor or not, had nothing to do with her, let alone what she cared about.

Ling Fei thought the people downstairs heard her shouting, so she came up with lazy steps, but she had completely forgotten that it was early morning.

Ding Jiuxi quickly thought of a solution for Xuan Che in his mind. Ding Jiuxi was not taking advantage of others' danger to ask Xuan Che to be Ding Xichen's teacher, but at this juncture, it seemed that this reason was the most convincing. Maybe this was the opportunity God had given Ding Jiuxi for her to seize.

Bu Qingyou's words made Yun Wanyi freeze there. He didn't know what to say for a moment. After a long time, he followed her out of Jingyang Palace in a daze and walked towards his own palace. He was immersed in his own thoughts along the way and couldn't extricate himself.

"Mom, you don't have to worry, isn't Zhu'er fine now?" Sheng Mingzhu said coquettishly, but glanced at Su Qingwan.

King Yin showed no respect at all, and looked so arrogant, as if he wanted to trample him under his feet.

Han Yi stared at her angrily, wishing to kill her immediately, but this was just a temporary impulse.

"Actually, you don't have to think too much. If you are free, just go to Tongxin Palace to find me, and I will ask the emperor to call Master Pei for you." Lin Chuxia held Concubine Qing's hand and said.

She slowly walked towards the pavilion. Ye Weiyang was sitting on the stone bench, with a pot of wine and two glasses on it. It seemed that he had been waiting for her here for a long time.

"Aunt Wang, my name is Guan Yi, and my wife Mu Rong, her father is Mu Guanghong..." Guan Yi enthusiastically introduced their identities to Wang Suqin.

But at this moment, something bad happened. There was a flash of inspiration, and City Lord Xin felt as if a steel needle was inserted directly from the top of his head. City Lord Xin screamed in pain and almost lost his breath.At this moment, Lucifer suddenly slapped City Lord Xin on the chest with his other hand.

It was not easy for her to recover from the pain of love poison, and she finally decided to forget everything in the past and start over with a different identity.

Although there are many variables, he has not yet become the emperor, but he has taken half a step to become a prince. This man is risking his life. The future is more important to him than anything else. He can sacrifice everything for the throne.

"Is this a student from your class? Look at what time it is. Why are you so late?" Zhang Cuiping pointed at Chu Feng, looking like she was going to accuse him.

The three of them were speechless for a while. Is it that simple?So wouldn't it be self-abuse for me and others to work hard for three months?

Bai Moqing obviously also discovered something strange. He looked at Ye Anmian quietly from the side, as if he wanted to discover some secret from Ye Anmian's face.

"Okay, the gossip ends here, now we officially start today's class." The teacher clapped his hands and pulled everyone back from their depression.
title_en: Chapter 580 In fact, I have been a Netherworld person for a long time
